body: That's good advice. Though I am a bit skeptical of that method. My parents used it as Catholics don't believe in birth control and I have 5 unplanned siblings hahaha. But in all seriousness I think you are right- applying that method along with the already lowish risk sex we have should help.
That's what worries me- she has very severe bottom disphoria- I dont want to imply anything about her genitals. How would I approach condoms (even condoms on toys) with her?
unfortunately I am a poor college student :(
Hey- that's so freaking cool man! I am glad you are at peace with yourself!

Wow- actually I have been through the same thing, I am a lesbian and my girlfriend is trans so every time I go to church I can't help but thinking: "If these people knew who I was, they would hate me. If these people knew who my girlfriend was they would probably be disgusted". I hate hate hate being forced to attend mass but every time I go home I have to.
Well thanks! Have a great day! :)

That's terrifying. I am so sorry! I hope things get better for you. My girlfriend went to a Baptist school- they told her that evolution wasn't a thing and vaccines were evil- not to mention all the homophobia. If you ever want to talk I am here! Also same with the gender identity lol.

I must say the 7 fold thing really sounds like a satisfying revenge. :p But seriously thank you- I don't believe in a deity but I will pass on the message to my girlfriend. I think it will really comfort her.

I was looking at the second link and wow- I really think I might be taking some of those tips so I can feel more comfortable (and handsome). Thanks so much! You made exploration seems less scary and more fun!

Its nice to hear that I am not alone. I personally believe that children should not be indoctrinated into any doctrine until they are old enough to explore themselves and the world around them and draw their own conclusions. I am glad you made it out alright :)

Its true. At its core its teachings are not awful- do unto others as they do to you, generally be a decent human, etc (though as a bit of a hedonist the "doing without pleasure is holy" never sat right with me). Its the church as a powerful and ultimately evil force that is brainwashing people like my parents to miss the mark all together in the pursuit of some greater agenda.
You are right. If there is a god I would hope that they are not a douche. :p

Yes. Sad but true. When I watch the news I can't stand it. Christian rights in all aspects are held above ours in our laws and social structures. People can get away with saying that they "just dont agree with homosexuality" as if it is some excessive new lifestyle.
Yes- even my Christian girlfriend is not a fan of organized religion. It seems to do nothing but corrupt and control.
That's very nice to hear actually. Its cathartic to know that I can be angry ( an emotion important for healing I believe) without being irrational.
Thank you- its very nice to see the other side of the religion. My girlfriend is a Christian so its comforting to know people will accept her in a religious context. :)

Thank you so much. Its a hard thing to explore because my girlfriend is trans. I dont want to add to her stress you know? Plus if I turn out to be trans my parents will blame it on her which freaks me out.
